rationale: The base station firmware was updated from 4.2 to 4.5, after which the kitchen camera (CAM-I2, hardware rev A) went offline. Logs show "E-305 protocol v2 not supported" and "OTA unavailable for hardware rev A": the camera speaks protocol v2 while the base station now supports only v3, and there is no OTA upgrade path for this hardware revision. Other devices (including the same-model Hall Cam) remain online, confirming this is a protocol incompatibility specific to the oldest camera, not a system-wide or signal fault.
